user_prompt: Is the core idea of this paper novel relative to the related work I gave you?
scope: The target paper target/paper.txt (arXiv:2106.09685, LoRA) and the supplied corpus of 10 real related-paper abstracts under corpus/, searched by search_repo and read by inspect_file; the novelty question is scoped to the target's STATED contribution and to subsumption BY THE SUPPLIED CORPUS ONLY (not the open literature).

claims.text: The target paper's stated contribution is identifiable from the supplied text (a low-rank additive weight-update adaptation that freezes pretrained weights).
The contribution is identified (C1) and the closest work in the supplied corpus has been located by search and inspected.

Under the supplied corpus and the declared search protocol, no inspected corpus item subsumes the target's stated contribution (trainable low-rank additive weight-update merged into the frozen weights with no added inference latency): the contribution stands as novel relative to this corpus.

atoms.proposition: The target's contribution paragraph is read via inspect_file over target/paper.txt.
The corpus is searched for the mechanism family with search_repo (pattern low-rank|adapter|prefix|prompt over corpus/), returning at least one match.
A closest-by-name corpus candidate (prefix-tuning, arXiv:2101.00190) is read via inspect_file.
The closest low-rank corpus candidate (Compacter, arXiv:2106.04647) is read via inspect_file.
Expert adjudication is obtained (ask_user) on whether any inspected corpus abstract claims the target's specific mechanism; the adjudication is that none does.

notes_for_annotators: Target arXiv:2106.09685 (LoRA), corpus of 10 real abstracts, all fetched 2026-07-28 from arxiv.org abs pages (provenance in artifacts/res-lora/PROVENANCE). ADJUDICATION (E5 answer, verified by reading the abstracts): No corpus item subsumes LoRA's stated contribution. LoRA = trainable low-rank additive weight-update (delta W = BA) merged into the frozen weights, giving zero added inference latency. The closest corpus items differ in mechanism: adapters (1902.00751) and Compacter (2106.04647) INSERT task modules (added latency; Compacter uses Kronecker products of slow/fast matrices); prefix-tuning (2101.00190), prompt-tuning (2104.08691) and P-tuning (2103.10385) PREPEND continuous vectors (reducing usable sequence length); BitFit (2106.10199) tunes biases; intrinsic-dimensionality (2012.13255) is an analysis, not an adaptation method; unified-PEFT (2110.04366) postdates the target and gives a unifying view, not the mechanism. Route minimality: E1 necessary (cannot judge novelty without reading the contribution); E2 necessary (the corpus must actually be searched, not assumed); E3, E4 necessary (the two nearest candidates must be read, not inferred from titles); E5 necessary (the subsumption call is the adjudicated conclusion). Order-coherence by containment. Decoy citation_count_lookup is not a listed action. The answer the ask_user tool returns is this note; E5 attests that the adjudication was obtained.
